'''Yan Pengu''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked at the [[Star Cluster Casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During a [[Soovada]] event, she determined that one of the guests was cheating. Pengu then asked a trusted associate to identify the cheater so that the bouncer [[Sellexith]] could kick them out.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yan Pengu appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Nightlife event quest giver.
